chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Sa'd ibn Abdillah narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Abu Ayyub from al-Subah ibn Sayabah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

Shall I not teach you something by which Allah will protect your face from the heat of Hell? He said: Yes. He said: Recite after Fajr: 'O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad' one hundred times, by which Allah will protect your face from the heat of Hell.
ai.seo_question: What is the reward for reciting Salawat 100 times after Fajr prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, this hadith highlights the specific virtue of post-Fajr devotion, linking the recitation of Salawat to the preservation of the face—a key indicator of honor in eschatological narratives—from the scorching heat of Hell. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on the intercessory power of the Prophet’s family and the spiritual purification achieved through consistent dhikr immediately after the dawn prayer. The promise of protection from Hellfire’s intensity reflects the broader theological concept that love for the Ahl al-Bayt serves as a shield against divine punishment.
